title: U.S. IPO monthly gross and net counts (IPOALL)
provider: Jay R. Ritter, University of Florida

definition.net: operating-company IPOs; excludes SPACs, closed-end funds, REITs, unit offers, ADRs, offer prices below $5, banks and S&Ls, limited partnerships, and non-CRSP listings
definition.gross: all IPOs including SPACs, direct listings, penny stocks, units and closed-end funds
